items.title: Amazon Prime Air maybe coming to a city near you
items.summary: Amazon (AMZN) is taking Prime Air to the next level. The tech and retail giant plans to expand its drone delivery service to nearly 500 U.S. cities and towns by the end of 2026, roughly a sixfold increase over its current footprint. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination to break down Amazon’s drone delivery ambitions and what customers can expect as Prime Air expands to tens of millions of people.

items.title: Walmart Earnings: The Biggest And Most Influential Retail Report Looms
items.summary: Walmart earnings are due early Thursday after a summer promotional pricing blitz to lure inflation-weary consumers.  On Wednesday, WMT stock edged higher, near a key level.  The big Dow Jones stock is the nation's and world's largest retailer by 2025 sales, according to the National Retail Federation.

items.title: The Unitree of It All: Why China IPO Surge Is Good News for Tesla
items.summary: If humanoid robots are the future, and they appear to be based on what investors are willing to pay, then Elon Musk faces a formidable Chinese rival.  Unitree Robotics  surged 460% on Wednesday in its trading debut in Shanghai, giving the company a market capitalization of about $51 billion.  Figure AI, which posts videos of its robots working in factories, has been valued at almost $40 billion.
